name: Enthalpy v0.4.26
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.26

## Changes

- Open from Sync opens the local workspace before all notes and attachments
  finish downloading. Files then download in the background.
- The Notes pane shows files that are still downloading. Select a note to
  give its download priority. You can create notes and edit available note
  text while other files download.
- Sync shows download progress and supports pause, retry, and recovery after
  an app restart. It also detects file changes made while the app was closed.
- Connection recovery keeps the record of files already saved locally.
  Incomplete desktop responses show a useful error instead of a JSON error.
- Windows closes the temporary workspace folder handle before it moves the
  folder to its final location. This prevents a failed connection after download.
- A connection can retry after a credential-storage error without a false
  "already reserved" error for the new folder.
- Sync can receive several remote changes between checks without an incorrect
  integrity stop. Background file checks wait for a verified download to finish
  saving its Sync state.

## Test this preview

This preview uses a separate test service and test account. Previous test
accounts and remote workspaces are not available on this service. Use the
private test login supplied with this preview. Versions before 0.4.26 cannot
use the new service.

Install 0.4.26 on both Windows and macOS. Sign in with the test account on both
computers. Create a new test workspace on the first computer and enable Sync.
On the second computer, select Open from Sync
and choose a new local folder outside OneDrive.
Check that the workspace opens while files download, that an available note
can be edited, and that Sync continues after an app restart.

## Known limits

This preview is the first part of the Sync redesign. It does not yet provide
full Sync feature parity. Concurrent edits to the same file still need more
work. Task changes can wait for required files to download. If an external
tool removes a folder before its files download, restore that folder before
you retry Sync. The original OneDrive failure still needs a Windows test.
